content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "Fair. You told me something real, a birthday with no phone, feeling hopeful for the first time in months after what sounds like a rough stretch, and finally putting a real boundary down with your team. That deserved more than a nice line back.

The walk with no phone sounds like exactly what was missing. Running on empty for this long and then choosing to actually disappear for two weeks, no half measures, that's the harder call to make, not the easier one.

Happy birthday, Lena. I hope the two weeks give you back more than you're expecting."

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
